Move a line without leaving the keyboard. More at [www.malgel.com](https://www.malgel.com).

## New

- **Move Line Up / Down** (Alt+↑ / Alt+↓, Option on macOS). The lines the selection touches move one line up or down and the selection travels with them, so a block of list items can be reordered without cutting and pasting. At the first line or the last, nothing happens, as in VS Code.

The editor library has no action for this, so it lives in Malgel's own formatting commands (`src/format.rs`) alongside Bold, Headings and Tidy table. Plain Alt with an arrow was free to take: the library already gives Ctrl+Alt+↑/↓ (and Shift+Alt+↑/↓) to adding a cursor above and below, and Alt+←/→ to moving by word.

## Downloads

| System | File |
| --- | --- |
| macOS 11+ (Apple silicon) | `Malgel-0.1.4-macos-arm64.dmg`: open it and drag Malgel to Applications |
| Windows 10+ | `Malgel-0.1.4-windows-x64-setup.exe` (installer) or `Malgel-0.1.4-windows-x64.zip` (portable) |
| Linux x86_64 | `Malgel-0.1.4-x86_64.AppImage` (`chmod +x` it, then run it) or `malgel-0.1.4-linux-x86_64.tar.gz` |

The macOS app is signed ad hoc and not notarized, so Gatekeeper blocks it after download: right-click it and choose Open once, or run `xattr -dr com.apple.quarantine /Applications/Malgel.app`. The Windows files are unsigned: SmartScreen may warn, and **More info → Run anyway** gets past it. `SHA256SUMS.txt` lists every file's checksum.
